title: LayoutDeleted
description: DELETE /api/layouts/<layout>?scene=<name> or ?room=<room> (contract §2.7, §4.9): the file moved to layouts/<scene>/.trash/<layout>-<UTC stamp>.json (a room's: layouts/@<room>/.trash/…). v1 also names the layout and scene; a room layout's answer names the room instead of the scene.

trash.description: <layouts dir name>/<scene>/.trash/<layout>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>[-n].json, or <layouts dir name>/@<room>/.trash/… for a room layout
